title: ‘Lifetime subscription to pressure’: Ex-cricketer’s blunt defence of Sanju Samson
content: Aakash Chopra has raised concerns about Sanju Samson's continued exclusion from the ODI squad. Despite impressive ODI statistics, Samson was overlooked for the New Zealand series. Chopra highlighted that multiple other wicketkeeper-batters were not selected either, indicating a possible decision on Samson's future. He compared performance metrics between Samson and other T20I players to support his point. This scrutiny comes as discussions around Samson's place in the team continue.

title: ‘Reveals his intentions’: Uttrakhand minister on husband’s demand to withdraw FIR
content: In a bold response to her husband's corruption allegations, Rekha Arya, the Women Empowerment and Child Development Minister of Uttarakhand, defends her reputation, asserting her financial records are clear and inviting a thorough investigation. Sahu's unsupported claims of illegal assets compel the formation of a Special Investigation Team. Arya highlights the vital role of women in speaking against domestic abuse, promoting empowerment and transparency amidst the tumult.

title: Google cofounder Sergey Brin donated $100 mn but cannot cast a vote next month
content: Sergey Brin has made a significant contribution against California's proposed billionaire wealth tax to avoid financial impacts. After relocating to Nevada, he is no longer eligible to vote on this measure. This one-time tax is set to apply only to California residents from 2026 if approved. Other tech billionaires like Eric Schmidt and Peter Thiel have joined Brin in opposing the tax.

title: Holy cow! Rs 20 lakh paid for a cowshed that doesn’t exist
content: A cowshed project in Dabhoura, Rewa district, has been marred by alleged fraud and incomplete work. Despite receiving over Rs 20 lakh, the project features only a partially built boundary wall. Investigators revealed that the tender process was allegedly manipulated to benefit a specific supplier, resulting in legal action against six individuals. The Economic Offences Wing is actively investigating the irregularities surrounding the project's funding and execution.

title: New Jersey court upholds will cutting two sons out of mother’s estate
content: A New Jersey mother who initially planned to divide her estate equally among her four children changed her will in 2016, excluding both sons after their relationship deteriorated. Following her death in 2024, the sons challenged the decision, alleging that their sisters had influenced her. One daughter had been her sole caregiver since 1996. However, on October 16, 2026, a New Jersey appeals court upheld the revised will.

title: 'It's murder': Big twist in Noida family deaths as dispute over property emerges
content: Five members of a family were found dead in their home in Nagla Shri Padam village on Saturday. Initial suspicions of food poisoning were ruled out as the cause of death remains unclear. Relatives have accused family members of involvement in a property dispute, which may have led to distress. Neighbors reported frequent arguments within the household before the tragic incident.

title: Driver, owner arrested after truck rams devotees near Gwalior temple; 15 killed
content: In a heartbreaking incident, 15 pilgrims lost their lives and 26 were injured when a truck crashed into them near Sheetla Mata Temple in Gwalior at 1:30 am. The police have arrested the driver and the truck owner, raising questions from families over the vehicle's entry into a restricted zone.

title: Florida protects 1,500 acres with $8.7m ranch easements
content: Florida has enacted a permanent conservation measure for two significant ranches located in Manatee and Highlands counties, encompassing nearly 1,500 acres. This initiative is designed to safeguard local agricultural practices and boost the economy. Through the Rural and Family Lands Protection Program, the state aims to uphold agricultural land under conservation, as stressed by Commissioner Wilton Simpson for forthcoming generations, highlighting Florida's intent to preserve its agricultural legacy sustainably.

title: Utah couple builds $2m backyard scuba paradise
content: In Utah, a dedicated couple has poured $2 million into an extraordinary backyard pool designed specifically for scuba diving. This stunning installation boasts a remarkable 90-foot artificial mountain, five magnificent waterfalls, and an exhilarating underwater tunnel. By creating such a bespoke sanctuary, they provide a fantastic recreational escapade for scuba lovers, complete with a lazy river and a fully equipped kitchen set within the mountain's embrace.

title: What is CXMT's 'Chinese chip bomb' that has wiped billions off the US stock market
content: China's CXMT has sent global memory chip stocks tumbling after claiming key progress on a denser 4F² DRAM design and plans for a server memory module by the end of 2026. Micron, SK Hynix and Samsung have lost billions in market value as investors question how long AI-driven memory profits can last. Here is what CXMT announced, why it matters and what analysts make of the threat.

title: Bob Dylan bought Scottish estate for £2.2m; 17 years later, it sold for £4.26m
content: In December 2023, Bob Dylan and his brother David Zimmerman listed their expansive Aultmore House estate for an impressive £4.257 million. This stunning 25-acre property, featuring 16 bedrooms, is nestled in the picturesque Cairngorms National Park. Since the onset of the Covid-19 pandemic, the siblings had not returned to the mansion, prompting their decision to sell.

title: Stock market outlook: Geopolitical cues, earnings, FIIs to keep Dalal Street busy
content: This week, Indian stock markets will likely be influenced by the quarterly earnings reports from key banks including HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and Axis Bank, showcasing different profit trends that are capturing investor interest. Traders will also keep a close eye on crude oil price shifts, geopolitical events, and foreign institutional investor movements, as well as the rupee-dollar exchange rate, to determine if the recent market resurgence is sustainable.

title: Gill falls for 1 run: India Test captain fails on Ranji return ahead of NZ Tests
content: Shubman Gill scored just one run for Punjab against Chhattisgarh in his Ranji Trophy return ahead of India’s Test series against New Zealand, starting November 19. Ajay Mandal dismissed him after five deliveries. Gill will play the first three New Zealand ODIs before preparing for the Tests. Despite the setback, he has scored 1,095 international runs this year, including four centuries.

title: ‘Chalo Yamuna Abhiyan’: Delhi CM Rekha Gupta joins cleanliness drive at ITO
content: In an effort to restore the Yamuna River's beauty, Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta took part in a cleanliness drive alongside her Cabinet colleagues and enthusiastic youth volunteers from local social groups. Together, they worked diligently to rid the riverbank of plastic and idol fragments, stressing the communal responsibility for the river's upkeep.

title: ‘Jailer 2’ box office collection day 4: Rajinikanth starrer sets sight on Rs 200 cr
content: The much-anticipated film 'Jailer 2', featuring Rajinikanth, has dominated the box office in its opening days, amassing an astonishing Rs 11.33 crore on its fourth day alone from 4,223 shows throughout India. With a total earning of Rs 155.38 crore, it has outpaced other films like 'Jana Nayagan' and 'Karuppu'. The Tamil version has led the charge, bolstered by strong performances and captivating music that keep audiences flocking to theaters.

title: ‘Pandal will collapse’: Announcement that may have triggered Kolkata stampede; watch
content: A stampede occurred at the Chorbagan Durga Puja pandal, leading to 19 fatalities and multiple injuries. Panic ensued after a warning announced the potential collapse of the pandal, contributing to the chaos. Police investigations revealed issues with crowd management and inadequate announcements during the event. The government has promised compensation for the victims' families and is reviewing safety protocols at puja pandals.

title: Gurgaon road rage: SUV rams car, driver 'grabs' woman by neck and pulls her T-shirt
content: A courageous woman in Gurgaon confronted an SUV driver after he crashed into her car, injuring her and her family. The encounter turned violent when the reportedly intoxicated driver attacked her, leading to bystanders stepping in. Authorities arrested him, filing charges under multiple laws. Medical reports verified the family's injuries, and an investigation into the drunk driving claims is actively progressing.

title: 'Darling, let's go to France': Trump takes swipe as protests take over the country
content: At a rally in Dalton, Georgia, Donald Trump took a lighthearted jab at France's revolutionary history while proposing a conditional payment of $5,000 to adult Americans if Republicans secure a midterm victory. He whimsically suggested that this money could be enjoyed in France instead of domestically, referencing current protests in France over financial strains and public services. The intention behind this proposal is to encourage spending within the US economy.

title: Travis Kelce's $5.35m mansion faces another property review

While the revised six-foot privacy fence received approval in September, the proposed rear landscaping remains unresolved. Neighbors have raised concerns about tree heights and potential damage to shared sewer lines. Bratenahl’s Architectural Review Board is scheduled to revisit the landscaping proposal on November 10, 2026, leaving parts of the property improvements pending.

title: How Tom Brady's childhood love for baseball cards inspired his business
content: Tom Brady's love for baseball cards began in his youth and has only deepened over the years. His treasured collection of Don Mattingly cards symbolizes his lifelong enthusiasm. Now, as a co-owner of CardVault, he is dedicated to enhancing the store's impact in the trading card world. Brady aims to enrich inventory and elevate customer experiences, striving to motivate a fresh wave of collectors through his entrepreneurial ventures.

This notice demands Khan to explain why his OCI card should not be revoked due to his involvement in a protest deemed unlawful. The Foreigners Regional Registration Office has raised concerns regarding public safety and security.

title: 21 BJP-RSS workers acquitted in SDPI activist’s murder in Keralam

The judge concluded that the prosecution was unable to substantiate its claims against the accused. Abid, who was assaulted by armed attackers while supporting his father near the Old Bus Stand, ultimately succumbed to his wounds despite nearby shopowners' attempts to assist.

title: Astronomers discover green star 280 light-years away; what makes it glow green
content: Astronomers have discovered an intriguing white dwarf star designated WD J1330+6435, nestled within the Draco constellation. Its striking green hue arises from the interaction of sodium and helium particles in its atmosphere. This celestial body lies about 280 light-years from Earth, presenting itself as it was 280 years ago. With a surface temperature nearing 4,000 degrees Celsius, its dimensions are comparable to that of our planet.

title: How Indian couples are spending crores to have a baby boy
content: Affluent Indian couples are increasingly opting for foreign IVF and surrogacy packages to ensure the birth of male children. Destinations such as the UAE, US, and Colombia offer advanced gender selection technologies, a practice not permitted in India. With costs ranging from ₹15 lakh to ₹1.7 crore, this trend prompts many to seek services abroad, particularly as regulatory changes within India prompt couples to explore international options.

title: Can hackers get into your fridge? Your smart home may be less safe than you think
content: As the prevalence of internet-connected devices grows, so do the vulnerabilities they present to consumers. Everyday items like refrigerators, surveillance cameras, and smart cars are at risk of cyber intrusion. Hackers can exploit these devices to steal personal data and disrupt vital services. Experts suggest measures such as changing default passwords, enabling two-factor authentication, and minimizing the number of online devices to mitigate these threats.

title: FPIs hit the sell button again: Rs 3.12 lakh crore exits Indian equities in 2026

Escalating crude oil prices and elevated US bond yields have swayed this selling behavior. Although there was a momentary resurgence in buying, the cautious investor sentiment prevails against a backdrop of global economic volatility.

title: ‘RR are at the top of the list’: Ashwin makes big revelation on Hardik Pandya trade

Protesters are demanding the chief proctor's resignation and a thorough independent inquiry into the incident, while university authorities argue that student representation continues through alternative electoral frameworks.

The notice was issued following his attendance at a protest, leading to claims of arbitrary detention.

title: Gwalior accident kills 14 devotees: PM Modi announces Rs 2 lakh relief for kin
content:
Gwalior Sheetla Mata Temple Truck Accident

NEW DELHI: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Sunday expressed grief over the deaths of 14 people after a truck crashed into devotees waiting near a temple in Madhya Pradesh's Gwalior and announced ex gratia compensation of Rs 2 lakh for the next of kin of each deceased. Nearly 40 people were injured in the accident, which took place early Sunday. PM Modi announced financial assistance of Rs 50,000 for each injured person from the Prime Minister's National Relief Fund (PMNRF). “Distressed to learn about the loss of lives due to a mishap in Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh. My condolences to the bereaved families. Praying for the speedy recovery of the injured,” Modi said in an X post. The prime minister said the next of kin of each deceased would receive Rs 2 lakh, while those injured would be given Rs 50,000 as financial assistance from the PMNRF.

End of Article
